lines.en: I have a second interview on Thursday and I am worried.
lines.tr: Perşembe ikinci görüşmem var ve endişeliyim.

lines.en: The first one went well, so they liked something.
lines.tr: İlki iyi geçti, demek bir şeyi beğendiler.

lines.en: This time it is with the manager, not the office.
lines.tr: Bu sefer ofisle değil, müdürle.

lines.en: What do you think he will ask?
lines.tr: Sence ne soracak?

lines.en: Probably why I left my last job after only one year.
lines.tr: Muhtemelen son işimden neden bir yıl sonra ayrıldığımı.

lines.en: What will you say?
lines.tr: Ne diyeceksin?

lines.en: The truth. The work was fine but there was nothing to learn.
lines.tr: Gerçeği. İş iyiydi ama öğrenecek bir şey yoktu.

lines.en: That is a good answer. Do not say anything bad about the people.
lines.tr: İyi bir cevap. İnsanlar hakkında kötü bir şey söyleme.

lines.en: I know. Nobody wants to hire somebody who complains.
lines.tr: Biliyorum. Kimse şikâyet eden birini işe almak istemez.

lines.en: Prepare two questions for him too. It shows interest.
lines.tr: Ona da iki soru hazırla. İlgi gösterir.

lines.en: What kind of questions?
lines.tr: Ne tür sorular?

lines.en: Ask what a normal week looks like. That is always useful.
lines.tr: Normal bir haftanın nasıl geçtiğini sor. Bu her zaman faydalıdır.

questions.q: Who is the second interview with?
questions.note: "This time it is with the manager."

questions.q: What does Pelin think he will ask?
options: Why she left her last job
questions.note: "Probably why I left my last job."

questions.q: What is her real reason?
questions.note: "The work was fine but there was nothing to learn."

questions.q: What does Emre tell her not to do?
options: Say bad things about the people
questions.note: "Do not say anything bad about the people."

questions.q: What question does Emre suggest?
options: What a normal week looks like
questions.note: "Ask what a normal week looks like."

lines.en: I lost my wallet this afternoon, somewhere in the city.
lines.tr: Bu öğleden sonra cüzdanımı kaybettim, şehirde bir yerde.

lines.en: Where were you between one and four?
lines.tr: Birle dört arası neredeydiniz?

lines.en: At the market, then a cafe, then the bus.
lines.tr: Pazarda, sonra bir kafede, sonra otobüste.

lines.en: Did you pay for the cafe with money from the wallet?
lines.tr: Kafeyi cüzdandaki parayla mı ödediniz?

lines.en: Yes. So I had it at three o'clock.
lines.tr: Evet. Yani saat üçte yanımdaydı.

lines.en: Then it went on the bus or at the bus stop.
lines.tr: O hâlde otobüste ya da durakta gitti.

lines.en: The bus was very full. I stood all the way.
lines.tr: Otobüs çok doluydu. Yol boyunca ayakta durdum.

lines.en: What was in it?
lines.tr: İçinde ne vardı?

lines.en: Two cards, a little money, and a photo of my daughter.
lines.tr: İki kart, biraz para ve kızımın bir fotoğrafı.

lines.en: Call the bank first, then fill in this form.
lines.tr: Önce bankayı arayın, sonra bu formu doldurun.

lines.en: Do people bring wallets here?
lines.tr: İnsanlar cüzdanları buraya getiriyor mu?

lines.en: More often than you think. Usually without the money.
lines.tr: Sandığınızdan sık. Genelde parasız.

questions.q: Where was Burak between one and four?
options: The market, a cafe and the bus
questions.note: "At the market, then a cafe, then the bus."

questions.q: How do they know he had it at three?
questions.note: "Yes. So I had it at three o'clock."

questions.q: What was the bus like?
questions.note: "The bus was very full."

questions.q: What does Burak mention last?
questions.note: "A photo of my daughter."

questions.q: What does the officer say about returned wallets?
questions.note: "Usually without the money."

lines.en: The soup was wonderful. Can you tell me how you make it?
lines.tr: Çorba harikaydı. Nasıl yaptığını söyler misin?

lines.en: Of course. It is very easy but it takes time.
lines.tr: Tabii. Çok kolay ama zaman alıyor.

lines.en: How long?
lines.tr: Ne kadar?

lines.en: Two hours, but you do nothing for most of it.
lines.tr: İki saat ama çoğunda bir şey yapmıyorsun.

lines.en: What do I need?
lines.tr: Neye ihtiyacım var?

lines.en: Red lentils, one onion, oil, salt and a little lemon.
lines.tr: Kırmızı mercimek, bir soğan, yağ, tuz ve biraz limon.

lines.en: That is all? My mother uses ten things.
lines.tr: Hepsi bu mu? Annem on şey kullanıyor.

lines.en: Ten things make a different soup, not a better one.
lines.tr: On şey farklı bir çorba yapar, daha iyisini değil.

lines.en: When do I put the lemon?
lines.tr: Limonu ne zaman koyayım?

lines.en: At the end, off the heat. That is the only important part.
lines.tr: Sonunda, ocaktan aldıktan sonra. Tek önemli kısım bu.

lines.en: I will try it on Sunday.
lines.tr: Pazar günü deneyeceğim.

lines.en: Call me if something goes wrong. It usually does the first time.
lines.tr: Bir şey ters giderse beni ara. İlk seferde genelde gider.

questions.q: How long does the soup take?
questions.note: "Two hours, but you do nothing for most of it."

questions.q: How many things does Nurten use?
questions.note: "Red lentils, one onion, oil, salt and a little lemon."

questions.q: What does Nurten say about using ten things?
options: It makes a different soup, not a better one
questions.note: "Ten things make a different soup, not a better one."

questions.q: When does the lemon go in?
options: At the end, off the heat
questions.note: "At the end, off the heat."

questions.q: What does Nurten say about the first time?
questions.note: "It usually does the first time."

items.title: Yeni bir şehre taşınmak
items.titleEn: Two Weeks in a New City

lines.en: How are the first two weeks?
lines.tr: İlk iki hafta nasıl geçiyor?

lines.en: The flat is good and the work is fine. The evenings are hard.
lines.tr: Ev iyi, iş de iyi. Akşamlar zor.

lines.en: Because you know nobody?
lines.tr: Kimseyi tanımadığın için mi?

lines.en: Yes. At home I always had somebody to call.
lines.tr: Evet. Memlekette hep arayacak biri vardı.

lines.en: Is there anybody friendly at work?
lines.tr: İşte cana yakın biri var mı?

lines.en: Two or three, but we only talk about the job.
lines.tr: İki üç kişi ama sadece işi konuşuyoruz.

lines.en: Ask one of them where they eat on Friday. That is how it starts.
lines.tr: Birine cuma nerede yediklerini sor. Böyle başlar.

lines.en: That feels strange after two weeks.
lines.tr: İki hafta sonra tuhaf geliyor.

lines.en: It is stranger after six months, believe me.
lines.tr: Altı ay sonra daha tuhaf oluyor, inan bana.

lines.en: You are right. There is also a running group near the park.
lines.tr: Haklısın. Ayrıca parkın yanında bir koşu grubu var.

lines.en: Go on Saturday. You do not have to talk when you run.
lines.tr: Cumartesi git. Koşarken konuşmak zorunda değilsin.

lines.en: That is exactly why it is a good idea.
lines.tr: Tam da bu yüzden iyi bir fikir.

questions.q: What is hard for Kaan?
questions.note: "The evenings are hard."

questions.q: What does he talk about at work?
questions.note: "We only talk about the job."

questions.q: What does Bora suggest first?
options: Ask where they eat on Friday
questions.note: "Ask one of them where they eat on Friday."

questions.q: Why does Bora say it will be stranger later?
options: After six months it is harder to start
questions.note: "It is stranger after six months."

questions.q: Why does Kaan like the running group?
options: You do not have to talk
questions.note: Son iki replik.

lines.en: I want to tell you before the fifth. My pay is coming late this month.
lines.tr: Beşinden önce size söylemek istiyorum. Bu ay maaşım geç geliyor.

lines.en: How late?
lines.tr: Ne kadar geç?

lines.en: The company said the twelfth instead of the first.
lines.tr: Şirket birinci yerine on ikisi dedi.

lines.en: Has this happened before?
lines.tr: Daha önce oldu mu?

lines.en: Not in two years. I have always paid on the fifth.
lines.tr: İki yıldır olmadı. Hep beşinde ödedim.

lines.en: That is true, and it is why I am not worried.
lines.tr: Doğru, zaten bu yüzden endişelenmiyorum.

lines.en: I can pay half on the fifth and half on the thirteenth.
lines.tr: Yarısını beşinde, yarısını on üçünde ödeyebilirim.

lines.en: Just pay all of it on the thirteenth. Two payments is more work for both of us.
lines.tr: Hepsini on üçünde ödeyin. İki ödeme ikimiz için de fazla iş.

lines.en: Thank you. I was worried about this call.
lines.tr: Teşekkür ederim. Bu telefon için endişeleniyordum.

lines.en: The people who call are never the problem.
lines.tr: Arayan insanlar hiçbir zaman sorun olmaz.

lines.en: I will send a message on the thirteenth.
lines.tr: On üçünde mesaj atarım.

lines.en: Good. And tell me early next time too.
lines.tr: Güzel. Bir dahaki sefere de erken haber verin.

questions.q: When will Ferda's pay come?
questions.note: "The company said the twelfth instead of the first."

questions.q: When does she usually pay?
options: At the end of the month
questions.note: "I have always paid on the fifth."

questions.q: Why is the landlord not worried?
options: She has always paid on time
questions.note: "That is true, and it is why I am not worried."

questions.q: What does the landlord prefer?
questions.note: "Just pay all of it on the thirteenth."

questions.q: What does the landlord say about people who call?
questions.note: "The people who call are never the problem."
